records.name: Eastern Zone of Europe

covers.boundary: except for RA2 and UA2-UI2

records.transcription_note: Published run 'UA1, UA2(except for RA2 and UA2-UI2), UA3. UA4,  UA5,UA6, UA7,UA9,UA9 (S,T,W)' split into one cover per prefix ('UA3.' recorded as 'UA3'). AMBIGUOUS: (a) UA2 is Kaliningrad's prefix (ARRL; Zone 15 here), so 'UA2 except for RA2 and UA2-UI2' has no evident remainder; mapped by prefix to ADIF 126 Kaliningrad, flagged. (b) A bare 'UA9' precedes 'UA9 (S,T,W)'; a bare UA9 would contradict Zones 17-18, so it is likely a stray duplicate; kept as published and mapped by prefix to ADIF 15 (Asiatic Russia). UA9 S/T/W (Orenburg, Bashkortostan per ADIF subdivisions) are ADIF 15 Asiatic Russia.
